 IREDA shares jump 7% despite 20% fall in one year on high trading volume | Check target, stop loss, stock performance
 IREDA shares opened at ₹ 111.62 apiece on the NSE, against their previous close of ₹ 111.46, and climbed to an intraday high of ₹ 119.58, marking a gain of around 7.3% from the previous closing price.
 IREDA Vaamanaa Sethi Published 9 Nov 2026, 03:04 PM IST Prefer Livemint on Google Indian Renewable Energy Development Agency (IREDA) shares rallied nearly 7% on Monday, November 9, amid strong buying interest and high trading volumes. ( AI generated image ) Indian Renewable Energy Development Agency ( IREDA ) shares rallied nearly 7% on Monday, November 9, amid strong buying interest and high trading volumes. IREDA share price opened at ₹ 111.62 apiece on the NSE, against their previous close of ₹ 111.46, and climbed to an intraday high of ₹ 119.58, marking a gain of around 7.3% from the previous closing price.
 The stock witnessed significant trading activity, with more than 3 crore shares changing hands by around 1:30 pm, indicating strong investor participation. The rally comes despite IREDA shares remaining under pressure over the longer term, having declined around 20% in the past year.
 The buying interest comes after the company's September-quarter results, which showed a sharp sequential improvement in profitability. Investors are also tracking the company's lending growth, asset quality and financing opportunities in India's renewable energy sector.
 IREDA Q2 results 2026
 IREDA reported almost flat net profit for the September quarter of FY27, while operating profit registered stronger growth and asset quality improved sequentially.
 The state-owned renewable energy lender posted a net profit of ₹ 552 crore, marginally higher by 0.5% compared with ₹ 549 crore in the year-ago period. Meanwhile, operating profit increased 16.5% year-on-year to ₹ 904 crore, against ₹ 776 crore reported in the corresponding quarter of the previous financial yea.
 Also Read | Divi's Laboratories shares hit record high rising 84% YTD; buy, sell or hold? The company's asset quality also improved compared with the preceding quarter. Gross non-performing assets (NPAs) declined to 3.57% from 3.76%, while net NPAs eased to 1.08% from 1.23%. The sequential improvement provides some relief, although investors will continue to monitor asset quality as IREDA expands its lending exposure to the renewable energy sector.
 IREDA share price returns
 Despite Monday's sharp rally, IREDA shares have remained under pressure over the past year. The stock has declined approximately 20.6% over the last 12 months, underperforming the broader market.
 The shares have traded in a 52-week range of ₹ 98.78 to ₹ 153.48. Monday's intraday high of ₹ 119.58 indicates a recovery from the recent lows, although the stock remains considerably below its 52-week peak.
 On the other hand, the stock has gained traction in recent sessions, with its one-week return turning positive by around 15.8%, reflecting improving near-term momentum
 IREDA share price outlook
 According to Mahesh M Ojha, VP Research & Business Development at Kantilal Chhaganlal Securities, IREDA shares have near-term upside potential, with a stop loss at ₹ 108 and successive upside targets at ₹ 124, ₹ 132 and ₹ 145.
 "IREDA shares can be considered with a stop loss of ₹ 108. On the upside, the stock may move towards ₹ 124, followed by ₹ 132 and ₹ 145-plus levels. Investors should maintain the prescribed stop loss to manage downside risk," the expert said.
